audit.why: Rakan wins every stage per packet.levelChart and content win[]/whys[] — his ranged W-Q, mobility, and instant ult beat Rell's grounded, telegraphed, point-blank kit at every phase.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[N].side were the placeholder 'Skill' while win[0..6] already all say Rakan, and several why texts were still generic rather than stating why Rakan wins.
audit.why: The chart token and its why must both name and justify the actual winner.
audit.corrected: Set all 7 phases[N].side to 'Rakan' and rewrite the whys to state the mobility/range advantage from whys[0..6].

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Rell's Q/W shield absorbs your burst window, and her E auto-attack reset has a wind-up tell you should read instead of the cast — neither is on the page. breakdown.cooldowns has no real number.
audit.why: All-in timing depends on both: force her shield out before committing, and step back at the E wind-up, not after the explosion lands.
audit.corrected: State Crash Down is a flat 10s cooldown, that her Q/W shields absorb your burst so bait them first, and that Full Tilt's auto-reset wind-up is your cue to back off.
